description: Canonical public schema for the South African retail AML simulation dataset. Each column includes its group, meaning, derivation rule, and observed unique values where categorical.

columns.name: Is_laundering
columns.description: Transaction-level synthetic target: 1 for a suspicious AML overlay and 0 for a legitimate baseline transaction.
columns.derivation_rule: Set to 1 when a suspicious typology overlay generates the transaction; otherwise set to 0 for the legitimate baseline.

columns.name: Transaction_id
columns.description: Unique synthetic identifier for the transaction; it is not a real banking identifier.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign a unique synthetic row identifier when transaction records are assembled.

columns.name: Time
columns.description: Synthetic transaction time of day, including salary or grant timing, routine spending periods, and rapid AML episodes.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample from the account profile schedule, including salary or grant timing, ordinary spending windows, and typology-specific timing.

columns.name: Date
columns.description: Calendar date on which the synthetic transaction occurs within the observation window.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample within the configured observation window after applying account activation and scenario scheduling rules.

columns.name: Account_id
columns.description: Synthetic identifier for the monitored receiver account used to group transaction histories.
columns.derivation_rule: Generate a unique random 9 to 11 digit synthetic account number for each monitored account.

columns.name: Sender_account
columns.description: Synthetic 9 to 11 digit account number on the sending side of the transaction.
columns.derivation_rule: Select the sender endpoint from the monitored account or synthetic counterparty endpoint pool according to direction.

columns.name: Receiver_account
columns.description: Synthetic 9 to 11 digit account number on the receiving side of the transaction.
columns.derivation_rule: Select the receiver endpoint from the monitored account or synthetic counterparty endpoint pool according to direction.

columns.name: Counterparty_account
columns.description: Synthetic account number for the counterparty associated with the monitored transaction; repeated values support network analysis.
columns.derivation_rule: Reuse or create a synthetic endpoint according to the customer's normal counterparties or the scenario network pattern.

columns.name: Direction
columns.description: Transaction direction relative to the monitored account: Inflow or Outflow.
columns.derivation_rule: Set relative to the monitored account from the selected sender and receiver endpoints.

columns.name: Amount
columns.description: Positive synthetic transaction value generated from customer profile, payment rail, timing, and behaviour distributions.
columns.derivation_rule: Draw a positive amount from profile, payment-rail, timing, and scenario-specific distributions with realistic overlap between classes.

columns.name: Payment_currency
columns.description: Currency associated with the payment source, such as ZAR, USD, BWP, LSL, or MZN.
columns.derivation_rule: Map the sending endpoint jurisdiction and payment route to its configured currency.

columns.name: Received_currency
columns.description: Currency associated with the receiving side of the payment, normally ZAR for domestic retail activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Map the receiving endpoint jurisdiction and payment route to its configured currency.

columns.name: Sender_bank_location
columns.description: Synthetic country or jurisdiction location of the sending bank or account.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign the synthetic sending endpoint jurisdiction from domestic, SADC, international, and FATF-context pools.

columns.name: Receiver_bank_location
columns.description: Synthetic country or jurisdiction location of the receiving bank or account.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign the synthetic receiving endpoint jurisdiction from the routed endpoint and scenario corridor.

columns.name: Counterparty_country
columns.description: Synthetic country associated with the transaction counterparty.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign the country attached to the selected counterparty endpoint and payment route.

columns.name: Payment_type
columns.description: Operational payment rail and not a laundering label; examples include Cash Deposit, Cash Withdrawal, Electronic Transfer, RTC, PayShap, Card Payment, Cheque, and International Wire.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample from the configured operational payment-rail mixture; grant and credit context are represented by indicators, not separate rails.

columns.name: Social_grant_indicator
columns.description: Binary indicator that the transaction is linked to a simulated social-grant flow.
columns.derivation_rule: Set to 1 when the transaction is generated from a grant receipt or grant-linked flow; otherwise set to 0.

columns.name: Social_grant_type
columns.description: Grant programme category when applicable; otherwise Not applicable.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign a configured grant programme to grant-linked flows and Not applicable to other transactions.

columns.name: Credit_card_indicator
columns.description: Binary indicator for credit-card context; it can occur in legitimate or suspicious activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from account or transaction credit-card context independently of the laundering label.

columns.name: Procurement_payment_indicator
columns.description: Binary indicator for a procurement-related payment context; it does not by itself imply laundering.
columns.derivation_rule: Set when the route or customer profile represents a procurement-related payment context.

columns.name: Virtual_asset_transaction_indicator
columns.description: Binary indicator that the transaction is associated with virtual-asset activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Set when the payment route represents a virtual-asset transaction or off-ramp.

columns.name: Counterparty_type
columns.description: Neutral functional role of the counterparty, such as household, merchant, employer, supplier, public sector, foreign, or financial service provider.
columns.derivation_rule: Map the endpoint role to a neutral functional category; do not encode the AML scenario name in this field.

columns.name: Cross_border_transaction
columns.description: Binary indicator that the transaction crosses national jurisdictions.
columns.derivation_rule: Set to 1 when sender and receiver jurisdictions differ, otherwise set to 0.

columns.name: SADC_corridor_transaction
columns.description: Binary indicator that the transaction uses a Southern African Development Community corridor.
columns.derivation_rule: Set to 1 when the route uses a configured SADC country corridor, otherwise set to 0.

columns.name: Jurisdiction_risk_tier
columns.description: Contextual jurisdiction tier derived from the synthetic countries and configured SADC or FATF groupings.
columns.derivation_rule: Derive from the routed country using the configured domestic, SADC, increased-monitoring, and call-for-action groupings.

columns.name: Customer_type
columns.description: Broad synthetic retail or organisational customer segment used to condition account behaviour.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample from the configured weighted customer-segment population before transaction generation.

columns.name: Employment_status
columns.description: Synthetic employment or livelihood status used to condition legitimate income and spending patterns.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign from customer type and socioeconomic profile rules.

columns.name: Employment_sector
columns.description: Synthetic sector associated with the customer profile, employment, or business activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign from customer type, employment status, and South African sector mixture rules.

columns.name: Monthly_income_estimate
columns.description: Synthetic monthly income or business-turnover estimate in ZAR; it is not an observed bank value.
columns.derivation_rule: Draw a ZAR estimate from the profile income band and employment or business context.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: South African province assigned to the monitored account profile.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample a South African province from the configured population weights.

columns.name: Grant_linked
columns.description: Binary account-level indicator for a grant-linked customer profile; it does not imply suspiciousness.
columns.derivation_rule: Set at account profile creation from the grant-recipient segment and retain it across the account history.

columns.name: Public_sector_exposure
columns.description: Binary contextual indicator for public-sector employment, income, procurement, or related exposure.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from public-sector employment, procurement, grant, or related account-profile context.

columns.name: Procurement_vendor
columns.description: Binary contextual indicator that the profile is associated with procurement-vendor activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from the customer profile and procurement-context assignment rules.

columns.name: PEP_category
columns.description: Synthetic politically exposed person context, including Not PEP, domestic or foreign prominent person, and family or associate.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign a configured PEP context independently of the transaction laundering label.

columns.name: Intermediary_account_flag
columns.description: Binary indicator for intermediary or connected-account context; it is not a transaction-level finding.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from intermediary, trust, or connected-account profile context and scenario routing.

columns.name: Virtual_asset_exposure
columns.description: Binary account-level indicator for exposure to virtual-asset service activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from account-level virtual-asset service exposure rules.

columns.name: Connected_party_count
columns.description: Non-negative count of synthetic connected-party relationships associated with the account profile.
columns.derivation_rule: Draw a non-negative count from account-type and connected-party profile distributions.

columns.name: Profile_jurisdiction_risk_tier
columns.description: Risk tier associated with the account profile's typical foreign-counterparty context.
columns.derivation_rule: Derive from the account profile's typical foreign-counterparty country.

columns.name: Laundering_type
columns.description: Scenario family assigned by the simulator for suspicious activity; non-suspicious rows are not assigned an AML type.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign the selected AML scenario family to suspicious overlays; leave non-suspicious baseline rows unassigned.
observed_values: Complex Legal Structure / Beneficial Ownership Obfuscation
Motor Vehicle or High-Value Goods Purchase
Stolen Student Loan or Grant Abuse

columns.name: Public_sector_counterparty
columns.description: Binary indicator for a public-sector or grant-payer counterparty; salary, grant, municipal, and procurement flows may qualify.
columns.derivation_rule: Set when the selected counterparty is a public-sector entity or grant payer.

columns.name: Scenario_reference_key
columns.description: Synthetic catalogue or source key identifying the behaviour definition used during generation.
columns.derivation_rule: Attach the catalogue or source key for the selected normal or suspicious behaviour definition.

columns.name: Scenario_detail
columns.description: Plain-language description of the simulated observable behaviour pattern.
columns.derivation_rule: Attach the plain-language observable-pattern description for the selected behaviour definition.

columns.name: Gender
columns.description: Synthetic demographic category for the account holder or profile.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample from the configured demographic distribution conditioned by customer profile.

columns.name: Age
columns.description: Synthetic age in years generated from customer and employment context.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample an integer age from customer type and employment-context age distributions.

columns.name: Education_level
columns.description: Synthetic highest or current education category.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample from customer type, age, and employment-context education distributions.

columns.name: Nationality_country
columns.description: Synthetic nationality or country association for the account profile.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample from configured South African, regional, and international profile distributions.

columns.name: Urban_rural
columns.description: Synthetic settlement context such as metro, township, small town, or rural.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign from province and settlement-context distributions.

columns.name: Township_or_informal_settlement_flag
columns.description: Binary indicator for township or informal-settlement context.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from the assigned settlement context and customer profile.

columns.name: Financial_inclusion_segment
columns.description: Synthetic access and usage segment such as banked digital, cash-reliant, thin-file, or grant-card dependent.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign from account access, grant, cash reliance, and digital-use context.

columns.name: Channel_preference
columns.description: Typical synthetic access channel, including card, mobile app, mixed cash/digital, branch or ATM, agent, or remittance app.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign from financial-inclusion segment and customer profile, then use it to condition payment rails.

columns.name: Informal_business_flag
columns.description: Binary indicator for participation in an informal-business context; legitimate informal trade is represented.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from informal-trader, business-owner, and informal-economy profile rules.

columns.name: Business_registration_status
columns.description: Compact business-registration category, including Not business, Registered, or Unregistered informal/small business.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign a compact registration category from customer and informal-business context.

columns.name: High_risk_sector_category
columns.description: Broad sector context used for risk-aware analysis, such as public procurement, property, high-value goods, gambling, metals, trade, crypto, or NPO activity.
columns.derivation_rule: Map the profile sector to a broad sector category without assigning suspiciousness by itself.

columns.name: High_risk_person_type
columns.description: Neutral profile-level exposure category for public officials, procurement, sanctions, adverse media, or standard retail context.
columns.derivation_rule: Map public-official, procurement, sanctions, adverse-media, or standard-retail context to a neutral category.

columns.name: Targeted_financial_sanctions_match
columns.description: Synthetic screening-context indicator; it is not proof of laundering or a transaction-level finding.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from the synthetic screening-context assignment and keep independent of the transaction label.

columns.name: Adverse_media_flag
columns.description: Synthetic adverse-media screening context; it is not proof of laundering.
columns.derivation_rule: Set from the synthetic adverse-media context assignment and keep independent of the transaction label.

columns.name: Typical_foreign_counterparty_country
columns.description: Synthetic country most associated with the profile's foreign-counterparty corridor; domestic profiles may contain South Africa.
columns.derivation_rule: Assign at profile creation from domestic, SADC, international, and FATF-context corridor rules.

columns.name: Account_open_date
columns.description: Synthetic date on which the account was opened, before or during the observation period.
columns.derivation_rule: Sample before or within the observation window using account lifecycle and opening-context rules.
